description: Calculate GST with preset rates of 0, 5, 12, 18 and 28 percent or a custom rate, in inclusive or exclusive mode. See the GST amount, base price and total breakup.

faqs.a: Exclusive adds GST on top: total = price + GST. Inclusive treats your amount as already containing GST and splits it out.
faqs.q: What is the difference between inclusive and exclusive GST?

faqs.a: Exclusive: GST = amount x rate/100. Inclusive: GST = amount - amount/(1 + rate/100).
Yes. Type any percentage in the custom rate field; the preset buttons will deselect automatically.
faqs.q: Can I use a custom GST rate?

howto: Pick a GST rate preset or type a custom rate.
Choose Exclusive (add GST) or Inclusive (GST included).
The GST amount, base price and total appear instantly.
title: GST Calculator
